name: round10_naive_vendor_onboarding_repeat
ground_truth_note: C is genuinely independent in this vendor_onboarding control. M1 and M2a depend only on the revoked B/M1 chain; M2b survives because C independently supports the conclusion.

domain.name: vendor_onboarding
domain.revoked_source: B: Vendor Northgate Logistics' self-submitted security compliance attestation, which claimed they meet SOC 2 requirements. This attestation has just been revoked (found to be self-reported and unverified, contrary to policy).
domain.independent_fact_c: C: An existing client of Northgate Logistics, contacted independently as a reference, confirmed in a signed reference letter that Northgate passed that client's own third-party SOC 2 audit last year -- a verification entirely separate from Northgate's own attestation.

m1.label: M1
m1.text: Northgate Logistics meets SOC 2 security requirements, per their submitted compliance attestation.

m2a.label: M2a
m2a.text: Northgate Logistics was approved for vendor onboarding, based on meeting SOC 2 requirements.

m2b.label: M2b
m2b.text: Procurement confirmed Northgate Logistics meets SOC 2 requirements, based on both their own attestation and the independent reference check confirming a third-party SOC 2 audit pass at an existing client.
